name: pdk-courlan-etl
instr:
Our seed lists now come straight from Common Crawl index queries instead of plain URL lists. Each file is a CDXJ extract with one capture per line (SURT key, timestamp, JSON record), and a sample from last month is /data/cc-index/cc-index-news-2026-09.cdxj. Running `courlan -i extract.cdxj -o out.txt -d discarded.txt` on it just discards every line.

Please make the `courlan` command read these extracts, with and without `--sample`, while plain URL lists keep working as before. A capture is live when its status is 200 and its mime is text/html or application/xhtml+xml, and failed otherwise. A redirect (a 3xx capture with a redirect target) means the page moved, so it counts as a live capture of the target at the same time and as a failed capture of the URL that redirected.

Captures whose URLs clean to the same output URL are one page, judged by its most recent capture. A page whose most recent capture is live is written once to the output, and every other page is listed once in the discarded file as the URL of its most recent capture. The usual checks and options (`--strict`, `--language`, `--parallel`) apply as for a plain list. With `--sample`, only live pages count, also for `--exclude-min` and `--exclude-max`. A line that can't be read as a capture goes to the discarded file unchanged and is otherwise skipped.

The existing tests and the ruff and mypy checks in /app/CONTRIBUTING.md should still pass. There's no network here.
